goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m looking to organise a little get-together and was wondering if your restaurant is any good for groups. We’re thinking of heading out this weekend, as the weather’s looking nice.

Oh, thanks for letting me know! Actually, we’re just a small bunch—there will only be five of us, so I’m hoping we can avoid the extra fuss with the private room. Do you have space for a group our size this Sunday evening?
We were thinking of 6:30pm, since it’s always nice to start early and linger over dinner when catching up. The booking would be under Marcus Bell—he’s the organiser of our little group.
Yes, that’s spot on! Five of us, this Sunday at 6:30pm, under Marcus Bell. Thanks so much for checking—looking forward to a lovely evening.
